glade-node.reason: accepted by the owner 2026-09-24 (plan Step 3.5), and again with shaku on 2026-09-24 (plan Step 3.2); sdax and sdax-tokio, and the dev-only sdax-testkit, all three pinned at one git rev, arrived at plan Step 3.3 (src/lifecycle.rs) and await the owner's re-review. Classifies the node as it now is, not a target shape: one crate holds the hand-written composition root and, beside it, the assembled one (run when GLADE_NODE_ASSEMBLED=1): an sdax plan that owns its start-up, every task it spawns and its cleanup (src/lifecycle.rs), with the Shaku assembly (src/assembly.rs) built inside one of its steps, and with the WS and iroh carriers, store, registry and sessions. It depends on the four Step 3.1 port contracts; on the assembled path it binds the system clock and the node's own record host, and fail-closed stand-ins for the carriers, the grant fold and the signer, whose real adapters are Phase 4's. The conformance target assembly runs those ports' suites against the test composition's deterministic providers, which live in test code; binding_census and shipped_app_files are integration tests, not a shared suite. LBT-009 is met for the deterministic providers only: no real adapter implements CarrierPort, GrantPort or SignerPort yet. Declaring another framework, or moving a port, a carrier, the assembly or the lifecycle into a crate of its own, is a policy change that re-reviews this entry.
